correctness.rationale: The source equations were reconstructed term by term. Model (2.2), its generator, and the later ANN Euler update all give infected drift \(\phi E-(\mu+\gamma+\phi_1)I\); Section 6.1 alone adds \(-\beta SI/N\). Algebraic summation gives target population drift \(\Lambda-\mu N-\phi_1I\) and printed-Milstein drift \(\Lambda-\mu N-\phi_1I-\beta SI/N\). The bundled symbolic verifier reproduces both identities and an exact rational witness. Risk: no source code was available, so the figure-level consequence is conditional on implementation of the printed formula.
